Eastern Arabic numbering
By way of intro, see http://www.docx4java.org/forums/pdf-output-f27/arabic-number-digits-in-pdf-output-t1826.html
"EASTERN Arabic" numerals in English: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Arabic_numerals or in Unicode, Arabic-Indic: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/1676 ... bic-digits
There are 2 settings in Word (as opposed to the docx!):
Use Native Digits = Context
digit substitution ( Control Panel -> Region and Language -> Addtional Settings -> Use Native Digits ) as Context

Numeral option	w:rtl	cs, no rtl	nothing	more context
(with hint)	eastAsia
=TNR	w:rFonts/@w:hint="cs"
System	Eastern	Eastern	1234	1234	1234	1234
Hindi	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern
Context	Eastern	Eastern	1234	1234	1234	1234*
Arabic	1234	1234	1234	1234	1234	1234

Use Native Digits = National
digit substitution ( Control Panel -> Region and Language -> Addtional Settings -> Use Native Digits ) as National
Numeral option	w:rtl	cs, no rtl	nothing	more context
(with hint)	eastAsia
=TNR	w:rFonts/@w:hint="cs"
System	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern
Hindi	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern
Context	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern
Arabic	1234	1234	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern	Eastern

Rules:
If rtl or cs is present, use eastern numbering, unless numer option = arabic.  Return ie (If both rtl and the hint are present, do what rtl tells you.
If Native Digit=National (and locale=??), use eastern
else if =Context, use 1234 unless numeric=hindi


  <w:themeFontLang w:val="it-IT" w:eastAsia="ko-KR" w:bidi="ar-SA"/>
  <w:themeFontLang w:val="en-US" w:bidi="ar-SA"/>


This stuff is implemented in RunFontSelector.
Basic tests:
    1. Native Digits=Context, Numeral option = System
    2. Native Digits=National, Numeral option = Arabic

Note: my test docx had Normal style set to include:
    <w:pPr>
      <w:bidi/>
    </w:pPr>
Haven't confirmed whether absence of that would make any difference...

See test docx:  src\test\resources\multilingual\arabic
